highlights: Comprehensive API: Langfuse is frequently used to power bespoke AI engineering workflows while using the building blocks provided by Langfuse via the API.
AI Gateway (beta) gives your organization one endpoint for calls to your model providers.
Metrics and Dashboards: Track latency, cost, and quality across any dimension with custom dashboards, the metrics API, and alerts.
Docker Compose: Run Langfuse on your own machine or a single virtual machine in 5 minutes.
